breakdown.description: The prompt switches from the exact thick-walled torsion relation given in the setup to a thin-walled tube approximation, which is a different model.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly resolved the inconsistency. The original prompt contained a contradiction by providing the exact formula for the polar moment of inertia (J) for a thick-walled tube while also instructing to use a thin-walled tube approximation. The ground truth resolves this by removing the instruction to use the thin-walled model. The agent's generated specification also removes this contradictory instruction and instead provides the correct standard torsion formulas that are consistent with the given formula for J.
